g.text: Where Nanocodex is faster — and where it is slower
Positive: Nanocodex faster. Negative: Agents faster. Median of paired reductions across low/medium/high × two repetitions.
Pairs match settings and repetition; they are not simultaneous requests. Completed outputs include incorrect results; consult correctness counts.
